objective: Make the FFXIV rug well-coded and stable in the game

checks.requirement: Render geometry, projection and lift from one current supported publication
checks.evidence: Immutable packet with cancellation tickets; seven regression cases cover replacement, failure, concurrent canceled producers, wrong scene and allocation-free render reads; final submission and optional character-pose assistance use the publication

checks.requirement: Keep complete measured support across thin overlapping collision surfaces
checks.evidence: Captured Limsa geometry regression and live 0.0.1.3 check: 7133 supported publications across 7133 updates, including a visual follow probe

checks.requirement: Do not let optional map texture loading hide supported cloth
checks.evidence: All three render paths use woven material when current map texture is absent; map-scaled routes are withheld; bounded mapprobe command prepared

checks.requirement: Keep foot protection valid through resource preparation and every GPU submission
checks.evidence: ClothFootSubmission regressions cover swept-envelope containment, original expiry, supersession, wrong zone, rollback, slow preparation and recovery; all fallback draw paths use the guard

checks.requirement: Distinguish sampling success from actual render submission and display evidence
checks.evidence: MCP render counters increment from actual renderer submission counters, independently of support publication counts; submission recency and refusal/fault state are exposed

checks.requirement: Handle plugin unload, reload, logout and resource lifetime without stale draws or failures
checks.evidence: Repeated controlled unload/reload and title-screen load succeed; native render locks and leases reviewed; CPU ownership tests pass

checks.requirement: Stay responsive and visible through representative motion and terrain
checks.evidence: Offline slopes, stairs, portals, bounded query scheduling and finite discovery tests pass; visual follow probe verified at one location

checks.requirement: Bound hot-path work and avoid recurring faults or allocation-driven stalls
checks.evidence: Existing query deadline and ray caps retained; new submission token is a value type and predicates are cached delegates; broader runtime profiling still needed

nextRuntimeChecks: With a logged-in character, establish support and render baselines and capture the visible rug
Run the ten-second mapprobe and verify woven rendering continues, then map rendering recovers automatically
Exercise native and background composition, check draw refusals and recovery, and restore the saved mode
Exercise movement, stairs, jumping, UI occlusion and zone transitions using measured support and actual display evidence
Check resource lifecycle, frame costs, allocation pressure and Rug errors during a sustained run
releaseGate: Keep the broader stability goal active until pending runtime checks have adequate evidence; do not treat green unit tests as live rendering certification
